input.label: feature
input.reply:
Thanks for the suggestion. This is a request for new APIs: helpers to spawn a child process, write to stdin, and read stdout/stderr and exit codes, plus TUI interaction. I couldn't run an issue search in this triage pass, so I haven't confirmed whether a similar request already exists. Please check for one before this goes further.

Vitest doesn't have CLI/TUI helpers like this today. You can already test CLI apps by using Node's `child_process` (`spawn`/`execa`) inside a normal test and asserting on stdout, stderr and the exit code. For TUIs, a pty or terminal-emulation library is usually needed. This may fit better as a separate library or plugin than as part of Vitest core.

To help the team judge it, please add a concrete example of the API you'd like and explain what existing tools like `execa` don't cover for you.
